target_customer: Consumer lenders, fintechs, BNPL and collections firms in the US and Latin America
problem: Lenders need to scale origination, servicing and collections without adding staff proportionally.
business_model: B2B SaaS of AI agents for lending operations

founders.name: Victor Laguna
founders.background_notes: Engineer and engineering manager on video products at Facebook per press; YC page lists him as CTO while a launch post calls him CEO

founders.name: Vladimir Korshin
founders.background_notes: Named by Seedtable and a YC launch post signed Vlad and Victor; YC company page names David, unresolved

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents over lending workflows need integrations and compliance care, but build on available models.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow integrations help but many agent startups target lending.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; other startups such as Kastle raised for the same wedge in 2026.

market_need_then: Lenders face high operating cost in origination and collections; no dated demand data was found for 2024.

brand_strength.rationale: The name collides with Tormach's PathPilot CNC controller and an unrelated career tool, which clutters search; no brand press found.

pivots.from: AI model for session replay data (UXOB)
pivots.to: AI agents for consumer lending operations
pivots.why: Not stated in sources found; timing unknown

outcome_analysis: PathPilot joined YC in Summer 2024, first launching a session replay AI model and later positioning as AI agents for lending operations, with a pre seed round in May 2025 from Alaya, Unpopular and Network.VC. It is active with three people and no later round found, so the outcome is too early to judge; crowded competition in lending agents is the visible risk.
notes: Amount of the May 2025 round is about 1.3 million dollars on CB Insights and Preqin only, so it is left null as unverified. Founder naming conflicts across sources. Pivot from session replay to lending is inferred from two YC pages and is not dated. Competition at founding not found in dated sources.
